title: GraphTopology
description: Domain-agnostic control graph topology. Describes the structure of a LangGraph control flow without naming specific actions. Used by attestation adapters for DAG construction, terminal path classification, and parent-edge resolution.

nodes.description: All node names in the graph (unordered set)

parentEdges.description: Maps each node to its possible parent nodes. Keys are node names, values are arrays of parent node names.

terminalNode.description: The canonical success terminal node (e.g., final action executor)

interruptNode.description: The node where HITL (human-in-the-loop) interrupts occur, if any

attestationNodes.description: Nodes that trigger attestation CER emission (unordered set)
